verdict.rationale: Trivy is a CLI-first scanner designed for headless/CI use, with documented CLI commands (trivy fs, trivy k8s, trivy image), distribution via brew/docker/binaries, and strong independent corroboration of CI integration ease and automation-friendliness from community reports. Missing for 10: no first-party CI-specific docs (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow templates) cited in this pack, and one community report notes a CLI crash on a specific subcommand.
